en: The image depicts a bustling historical public square with numerous people, carriages, and market activity. The background shows a large, Gothic-style brick church with a tall spire, surrounded by several multi-story, ornately decorated buildings typical of northern German architecture. The colors and printing style suggest a hand-colored photo from the late 19th or early 20th century. The lower margin contains the printed text 'Rostock. Neuer Markt und Marienkirche.', and there is handwritten script in German along the bottom and up the right side.
